description: Honduras's National Statistics Institute publishes the housing volume of the 2013 XVII Population and VI Housing Census, a 661 page PDF of 15 statistical tables with definitions and the census questionnaire. The tables count private and collective dwellings by occupancy and type, and occupied private dwellings by class of lighting, kitchen and cooking energy, piped water and water source, sanitation service, waste disposal, household equipment, cable television and internet services, vehicles, materials, rooms and tenure. Coverage is national, for the 18 departments, each split into urban and rural areas; the census page also links municipal volumes for the 298 municipalities, grouped by department, and a Redatam web portal for processing the 2013 census base online. Format and access: free PDF download and an open Redatam portal served over plain HTTP from a numeric address. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the tables are in a PDF; the link on the census page points to a temp.ine.gob.hn host that the cloud could not reach, while the same file path on ine.gob.hn works; a new census was announced for 2026. Simulation uses: departmental water, sanitation, electric lighting and waste service gaps, with urban and rural splits, for service planning. Related records: the ONE Dominican Republic Censo 2010 Redatam base.
